listing.name: God of War: Ghost of Sparta — God of War PSP native ports (DrummingBird1)
listing.original_game_title: God of War: Ghost of Sparta
listing.summary: The v1.2.1 launcher builds locally with pinned portable tools. Upstream reports automated tours loading every level, but neither game has a complete playthrough confirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA UCUS98737 CHD or ISO. Keep that image available while playing.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract GoW_PSP_Launcher-v1.2.1.zip and choose Build after reviewing and consenting to its tool setup. It uses hash-pinned portable Clang, CMake and Ninja to generate C code and game binaries locally; Visual Studio is not needed. Keep your CHD or ISO for disc reads while playing.

warnings: The v1.2.1 launcher builds locally with pinned portable tools. Upstream reports automated tours loading every level, but neither game has a complete playthrough confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
